package nats

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"time"

	natsgo "github.com/nats-io/nats.go"
	"go.uber.org/zap"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
)

const (
	DialogContextMutationConsumerQueue   = "ms-teacher-dialog-context-mutated"
	DialogContextMutationConsumerDurable = "ms-teacher-dialog-context-mutated-v1"
	maximumDialogContextMutationBytes    = 4 << 10
)

type dialogTeacherContextMutatedEnvelope struct {
	SchemaVersion     int       `json:"schema_version"`
	EventID           string    `json:"event_id"`
	EventType         string    `json:"event_type"`
	OccurredAt        time.Time `json:"occurred_at"`
	DialogID          string    `json:"dialog_id"`
	EventSequence     int64     `json:"event_sequence"`
	StudentID         string    `json:"student_id"`
	PersonalTeacherID string    `json:"personal_teacher_id"`
	ContextType       string    `json:"context_type"`
	ContextID         *string   `json:"context_id"`
	MessageID         string    `json:"message_id"`
	MessageSequence   int64     `json:"message_sequence"`
	MessageVersion    int       `json:"message_version"`
	LastEventSequence int64     `json:"last_event_sequence"`
	Mutation          string    `json:"mutation"`
}

func DecodeDialogTeacherContextMutated(payload []byte) (domain.DialogTeacherContextMutation, error) {
	if len(payload) == 0 || len(payload) > maximumDialogContextMutationBytes {
		return domain.DialogTeacherContextMutation{}, errors.New("dialog teacher context mutation payload is empty or oversized")
	}
	var envelope dialogTeacherContextMutatedEnvelope
	if err := decodeStrictJSON(payload, &envelope); err != nil {
		return domain.DialogTeacherContextMutation{}, fmt.Errorf("decode dialog teacher context mutation: %w", err)
	}
	contextType, err := normalizeDialogContextType(envelope.ContextType)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DialogTeacherContextMutation{}, err
	}
	return domain.NewDialogTeacherContextMutation(domain.DialogTeacherContextMutation{
		SchemaVersion: envelope.SchemaVersion, EventID: envelope.EventID, EventType: envelope.EventType,
		OccurredAt: envelope.OccurredAt, DialogID: envelope.DialogID, EventSequence: envelope.EventSequence,
		StudentID: envelope.StudentID, PersonalTeacherID: envelope.PersonalTeacherID,
		ContextType: contextType, ContextID: optionalString(envelope.ContextID), MessageID: envelope.MessageID,
		MessageSequence: envelope.MessageSequence, MessageVersion: envelope.MessageVersion,
		LastEventSequence: envelope.LastEventSequence,
		Mutation:          domain.DialogTeacherContextMutationKind(envelope.Mutation),
	})
}

type DialogTeacherContextMutatedSubscriber struct {
	Conn       *natsgo.Conn
	Handler    func(context.Context, domain.DialogTeacherContextMutation) (bool, error)
	Logger     *zap.Logger
	AckWait    time.Duration
	RetryDelay time.Duration
}

func (subscriber DialogTeacherContextMutatedSubscriber) Subscribe(ctx context.Context) error {
	if subscriber.Conn == nil || subscriber.Handler == nil {
		return errors.New("dialog teacher context mutation subscriber connection and handler are required")
	}
	logger := subscriber.Logger
	if logger == nil {
		logger = zap.NewNop()
	}
	ackWait := subscriber.AckWait
	if ackWait <= 0 {
		ackWait = 30 * time.Second
	}
	retryDelay := subscriber.RetryDelay
	if retryDelay <= 0 {
		retryDelay = 5 * time.Second
	}
	jetStream, err := subscriber.Conn.JetStream()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_, err = jetStream.QueueSubscribe(
		domain.SubjectDialogTeacherContextMutated,
		DialogContextMutationConsumerQueue,
		func(message *natsgo.Msg) {
			mutation, decodeErr := DecodeDialogTeacherContextMutated(message.Data)
			if decodeErr != nil {
				logger.Warn("terminate invalid dialog teacher context mutation", zap.Error(decodeErr))
				_ = message.Term()
				return
			}
			processed, handleErr := subscriber.Handler(ctx, mutation)
			if handleErr != nil {
				if terminateDialogTeacherContextMutation(handleErr) {
					logger.Warn("terminate conflicting dialog teacher context mutation", zap.String("event_id", mutation.EventID), zap.Error(handleErr))
					_ = message.Term()
					return
				}
				logger.Warn("retry dialog teacher context mutation", zap.String("event_id", mutation.EventID), zap.Error(handleErr))
				_ = message.NakWithDelay(retryDelay)
				return
			}
			if ackErr := message.AckSync(); ackErr != nil {
				logger.Warn("ack dialog teacher context mutation", zap.String("event_id", mutation.EventID), zap.Error(ackErr))
				return
			}
			logger.Debug("dialog teacher context mutation handled", zap.String("event_id", mutation.EventID), zap.Bool("processed", processed))
		},
		natsgo.BindStream(DialogEventsStream), natsgo.Durable(DialogContextMutationConsumerDurable),
		natsgo.ManualAck(), natsgo.AckExplicit(), natsgo.DeliverAll(), natsgo.AckWait(ackWait),
	)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return subscriber.Conn.FlushTimeout(5 * time.Second)
}

func terminateDialogTeacherContextMutation(err error) bool {
	return errors.Is(err, domain.ErrDialogTeacherContextMutationConflict) ||
		errors.Is(err, domain.ErrInvalidDialogTeacherContextMutation)
}
